title: Test the hand-written browser_ tool names in prompts against DASHBOARD_TOOLS
notes: work-card-skill.ts:84-88, ship/review.ts:170 and workers/dispatch.ts:96 name browser_ tools by hand, and no test checks those names against DASHBOARD_TOOLS. If a tool is renamed, the tests still pass and sessions call a tool that no longer exists. Fix: one test that checks every browser_<verb> in those texts is a DASHBOARD_TOOLS name. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/361 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/360#discussion_r4685057629
